latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate professional, export-ready Instagram carousels as self-contained HTML.

- Mandatory creative-direction kickoff: always ask about color palette and tone of voice for every carousel.
- Step-by-step workflow covering brand info collection, color system derivation, and real data/statistics sourcing.
- Strict rules for modern, consistent color palettes based on brand identity.
- Verified, up-to-date stats and case studies required for each carousel, with a data freshness audit.
- Clear language rules: simple, beginner-friendly Russian writing by default; avoid jargon and vague phrasing.
- Triggers only for Instagram carousels and social media slides, not for PowerPoint, PDFs, or non-Instagram use cases.
